title: Who is Phoebe? Wuthering Waves
sources: https://wutheringwaves.kurogames.com official news 2106 'Profile Reveal | Graceful Luminescence — Phoebe': Acolyte of the Order of the Deep, a young woman of quiet devotion; her prayers, like the light she carries, offer comfort and peace. Attribute Spectro, Weapon Rectifier, 5 stars

Official news 2101 'Post-Lament Anthropocene: Stars Intertwined | Phoebe' lore images: Thoughts ('When I was a child, I awoke on a dark shore. I walked that shore for what felt like forever until I saw a light... a few kind Acolytes of the Order brought me to a brightly lit room... they became my adoptive family'); Resonance Evaluation Report (her Resonance Ability allowed her to manifest light, refracting it into various forms of prisms; even on the darkest nights she fills every room with a soft, radiant glow); A Special Staff (bird-like head; with a gentle swing she knocks humans and Echoes out of negative emotions); Please Calm Down! (a pizza argument outside Margherita's, resolved with one swing); Beloved Friends (she can distinguish common Echoes, 'a walking encyclopedia of Ragunnesi Echoes'; Echoes behave like eager puppies around her); Phoebe's Favorite Food (Pizza Day was the only day of the month they were allowed pizza at the orphanage)
Art: official Kuro Games images, cropped only (see presskit/SOURCE.txt), credited on screen

scenes.narration: She can knock the anger right out of you, with one gentle swing of her staff. This is Phoebe, Acolyte of the Order of the Deep.
As a child, she woke up alone on a dark shore. She walked until she saw a light: Acolytes of the Order, who took her in.
Her Resonance lets her create light and split it into prisms. On the darkest nights, she can fill a whole room with a soft glow.
When a fight breaks out, like a pizza argument outside Margherita's, she calls for calm, and one swing of her staff settles it.
Echoes adore her. She can tell even common Echoes apart, and they follow her around like eager puppies.
She's a five-star Spectro Resonator. And her favorite food? Pizza. At the orphanage, Pizza Day was the only day they could have it.
So, has Phoebe's gentle swing ever calmed you down? Tell me in the comments.
